All observed behavior is consistent with standard, safe AUR packaging practices.

No evidence of data exfiltration, dynamic code loading, or execution of unpinned or remote code is present in the metadata. The sources are pinned to a specific release tag (`v2.2.13`), and the checksums match known good values for that release. While the package is distributed as a prebuilt binary (common for Go/Rust tools), the verifiable checksums and trusted upstream source mitigate supply-chain risks.
